queries:
WITH g AS (
    SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS A3, AVG(o.amount) AS grp_avg
    FROM "order" o
    JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE o.amount > 2802
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
)
SELECT account_id, A3, grp_avg - (SELECT AVG(grp_avg) FROM g) AS diff
FROM g
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE amount >= 2802;
